nodes.label: Case Detail Modal – Distribuidora Nexo Comercial (ERP Contract Dispute)
nodes.description: UI screenshot of a case detail modal dialog in the Captio platform (Spanish locale). The case belongs to 'Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.' under the business category 'Negocios / contrato'. The status workflow shown is: Invitado → Nuevo → En revisión (currently active) → Consulta agendada → Revisión de conflicto → Cliente aceptado ✓ → Rechazado → Cerrado. Action buttons include Editar, Respuestas del cliente, Descargar HTML, and Eliminar. A text highlighter color-picker tooltip is visible. The case classification is 'Contrato de servicios — Incumplimiento y defectos en implementación de sistema ERP'. Key facts visible: ERP implementation contract for $1.8M MXN with NovaSoft Sistemas S.A. de C.V.; client paid $1.08M MXN advance in March 2024; system delivered with 47 documented incidents, 12 unresolved 5 months after deadline (15 Sep 2024, actual delivery 30 Sep 2024); quantified damages $2.4M MXN in cancelled orders + $800k MXN in corporate client SLA penalties; NovaSoft offered 20% discount on remaining balance, client refused; formal non-compliance notice 5 Dec 2024; client seeks rescission, advance refund, lost-profit indemnification, and performance bond execution; main risk is possible counter-claim for 'requirements change' and NovaSoft dissolution. Timeline shows a demo client entry generated 4/6/2026 at 1:01:18 p.m.
